leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a function that accepts a 2D board and a target word as parameters.
Initialize a depth-first search (DFS) algorithm to traverse adjacent cells.
Implement backtracking logic to mark visited cells and restore them.
Configure boundary checks to prevent index out-of-range errors.
Manipulate the board data structure to compare characters during the search.
Integrate the DFS helper function within the main search function to coordinate the process.
Render a boolean result indicating whether the word exists in the board.
